title: Measurability of the tangential Jacobian from measurability of the tangent projection
statement: Let μ be a measure on E := ℝ^P, Q : E → {subspaces of E} and L : E → End(E) such that x ↦ (orthogonal projection onto Q(x)) and x ↦ L(x) are μ-a.e. strongly measurable. Then x ↦ (det(L(x)e_a · L(x)e_b)_{a,b})^{1/2}, where e is the standard orthonormal basis of Q(x), is μ-a.e. strongly measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (L : Euclid P → (Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P)), AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (Q x).starProjection) μ → AEStronglyMeasurable L μ → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (Q x)) => inner ℝ (L x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x) i)) (L x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (Q x) j))))) μ
